description: Runs the prison under the lighthouse. Used to be a paladin, broke his oath when he let a prisoner drown. Now he's bound to the place and can't leave. description: River spirit that takes the shape of whoever the victim misses most. Lures people into the water. Not evil exactly, just lonely. Can't leave the river. Should be a social encounter first and a fight only if it goes wrong. Charm, drowning, turns to mist when hurt.

description: Gnoll warlord for my level 6 party's boss fight. Has a pet hyena that fights next to him. Uses a flail and a longbow. Gets a free bite when he drops someone. I want him to feel scary when he's low on health, like he fights harder.

My players are going into a wizard's abandoned tower and I need the thing that's been living in the library. It was the wizard's familiar, a cat, but it's been eating spell scrolls for 50 years. Now it's the size of a horse and casts random spells when it attacks. Teleports short distances. Hates being looked at.
